## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Western Jìn translation of a discourse on the four wonderful qualities (*acchariya-abbhūta-dhamma*) of a Wheel-turning King — the qualities by which his subjects, his elephant-treasure, his horse-treasure, and his jewel-treasure are all delighted by the sight of him. The Chinese parallel is T125[42.3]; this is a doublet of [T138](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0138) but covers a different sub-set of the *Ekottara* material on the same theme.

**Abstract**

T139 was produced during Dharmarakṣa's Western Jìn career (266–313 CE), recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
